adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous logic did `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)`, logged `tokenResponse.error` and `responseJson` on failure, and then continued (updating credentials with the unmodified `o365AuthCredentials`). The new code uses `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`, which throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when parsing fails and no longer logs the provider response/error context. This is a real behavior/diagnostics change visible in the diff, though whether throwing is "wrong" is not provable as a correctness defect from the diff alone.
